name: ParadeDB Community (pg_search)
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 Community PostgreSQL extension providing full-text and hybrid/vector search, BM25 ranking, filtering and aggregations; self-host with no vendor software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires a compatible PostgreSQL deployment, your own compute/storage and operational maintenance. AGPL-3.0 source-sharing obligations can apply to modified network-served versions; Enterprise features, commercial licensing and ParadeDB Cloud are separate.
